summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for pleuritic chest pain and concern for pulmonary embolism given her history of recurrent DVT/PE. CT angiography ruled out pulmonary embolism but revealed a new L1 compression fracture and chronic rib fractures. A CT of the sinuses showed acute frontal and chronic maxillary sinusitis, which was treated with levaquin. Her chest pain resolved during the admission. She also reported persistent bloating, attributed to her known gastroparesis, and was continued on metoclopramide and simethicone. Her chronic GVHD, diabetes, and pain from prior fractures were managed with her baseline medications. She remained stable, completed treatment, and was discharged home with follow-up plans.
problems: Closed fracture of multiple ribs, unspecified
Osteoarthrosis, localized, not specified whether primary or secondary, pelvic region and thigh
Diabetes mellitus without mention of complication, type II or unspecified type, not stated as uncontrolled
